material_finding.summary: The donor already creates and persists round-scoped retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, generation and query_hash, but the later Stop relevance-cognition interface carries only session_id plus transcript_path. The model-feedback path therefore reconstructs both target retrieval and query indirectly at Stop time instead of consuming the exact identity produced at retrieval time.

source_crosscheck.finding: MicroClay.retrieve persists retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id, generation and query_hash in retrieval_episodes and returns retrieval_id/query digest in its receipt.
_microclay_schatten deliberately creates fresh causal_id, turn_id and episode_id per UserPromptSubmit and passes them into retrieve, specifically to make repeated same-session rounds distinct.

_kognition_richten_hook receives only session_id/transcript_path, selects ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1 among same-session rows without modell:relevanz, then separately resolves the last user message from transcript_path before applying credit to the selected row.
Stop calls _kognition_richten_hook(session_id, transcript_path); no retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id or generation crosses this control boundary.

observed: Round-scoped retrieval identity exists before Stop.
Stop relevance cognition does not receive that identity.
Target retrieval row is rediscovered by session_id/newest-open ordering.
Query text is rediscovered independently as the last user message in the transcript.
causal_analysis.inference: If Stop processing overlaps, reorders, is delayed, or sees more than one uncredited same-session retrieval, the independently reconstructed target row and query can plausibly refer to different rounds.
causal_analysis.falsifier: Execute two same-session retrieval rounds with distinct retrieval_id/turn_id/query, deliberately reverse/interleave Stop relevance processing, and prove that each model-derived feedback receipt binds to the intended retrieval_id and matching query identity. A source-only result cannot close this gate.
causal_analysis.counterhypothesis: Installed hook scheduling may serialize the relevant events strongly enough that session-newest selection never misbinds in practice; only an executable interleaving test can establish that.

rules: Construct the candidate from the exact retrieval receipt/row; do not rediscover a target by newest same-session ordering.
Carry query identity with the candidate. If raw query text is required for inference, bind it to query_hash/value provenance rather than reading an unrelated latest transcript message later.
Model output remains candidate evidence only; deterministic reducer remains the sole writer of retrieval_feedback/policy updates.
Reject stale generation, unknown retrieval_id, identity mismatch, duplicate receipt, source/build mismatch and query-hash mismatch fail-closed.
Run relevance inference outside deterministic Stop completion authority per the preceding Stop-hook boundary delta.
Preserve the existing round-scoped identity generation and retrieval ledger; repair the handoff rather than introducing a second state store.

grid_mapping.producer: retrieval cell / Typed Entry-admitted retrieval path

contradictions_preserved: The donor intentionally repaired retrieval rounds to be round-scoped, yet downstream model relevance still uses session-scoped rediscovery.
Rich causal identity is stored, but the Stop cognition ABI behaves as if only session identity were available.

required_actions: Use the exact retrieval receipt to construct RetrievalRelevanceCandidate/v1 with immutable retrieval/turn/episode/causal/generation/query identity.
Add a two-round same-session reverse-completion test that fails on any cross-attachment.
Add query-hash/value binding so the model cannot judge retrieval A using transcript query B.
Keep Frank Harness untouched; use donor-side tests/external test lane under current authority.
Retain runtime, canonical-semantics, physical GRID10 and training credit at zero until executable gates pass.
